readingCoverage.method: Correct per-section copies were read in bounded batches. Complete assigned source content was consumed; retained command output was used to recover display omissions without rereading files.

priorityDefinitions.P1: Concrete inspected behavior contradicts a safety or truthful-completion requirement.
priorityDefinitions.P2: Required customer outcome is incomplete or not evidenced in the inspected integration paths.

limitations: Implementation evidence describes inspected local source, not confirmed shipped or deployed behavior.
Absence from an inspected path is not a repository-wide nonexistence claim.

Exact blueprint route and feature-flag bindings remain unverified in this bounded capability audit.

firstFoundationDependency.description: The matrix/foundation dependency remains pending. Agree the shared capability-to-route/flag/tool/domain-service mapping and execution envelope before implementing capability slices.
reuse: Existing domain services and trust/approval integration

evidence.observation: Registry imports calendar, tasks, groceries, reminders, family and notifications tool sets, not most assigned capability-level tool families.
The assistant combines legacy, action and registry bridges; existing CRUD/action capability must be reused rather than discarded.

firstFoundationDependency.firstSafeSlice: Parent establishes the mapping and reusable typed read/propose/write contract: domain/object authorization, exact approval, idempotency, canonical persistence, AgentRun/source/result evidence and recovery. This audit implements none of that foundation.

capabilities.name: Chief of Staff

required.customerOutcome: A broad household goal becomes a persisted cross-domain dependency plan, safe completed actions, exact approvals and an explainable progress record.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Goal composition, plan editing, per-step approval/status/source timeline and failed-step recovery over canonical household records and linked AgentRuns.

evidence.observation: Command-center signals link to existing modules rather than presenting an executable household dependency plan.
The inspected execution path persists conversation messages and tool results; this is not evidence of persisted goal dependency nodes and per-node recovery.

gaps.description: Prepare-next-week and handle-everything workflows are not evidenced as persisted dependency-aware plans with exact approvals and failed-step-only retry.
The typed registry does not register the required goal.plan, goal.execute and brief.generate capability family; existing individual action tools are not equivalent proof.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: After the parent foundation is agreed, connect a bounded next-week goal to existing calendar/task/meal services using persisted plan nodes, approval decisions, result IDs and retryable step state. Do not rebuild existing CRUD screens.

capabilities.name: Household Autopilot

required.customerOutcome: Repeated household sequences become approved, bounded workflows that execute real steps and support pause, skip, run-now, history and drift handling.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Editable workflow/template UI, scoped approval, step/run history and limits integrated with calendar, gear, meals, drivers, tasks and reminders.

evidence.observation: Missing dinner plans generate a plan_meals suggestion with a Plan dinners action.
The approval handler performs a domain insert only for create_reminder, then marks other action types approved and reports that Bubaly handled the action.
The scan auto-executes reminder and grocery actions; the inspected scan does not provide a plan_meals execution path that repairs the approval handler's missing action.
The rule form captures name, trigger, action and approval configuration; it does not evidence the required visual multi-step execution and recovery workflow.

gaps.description: Approving Plan dinners can mark the suggestion handled without creating a meal plan. This is a static call-path finding, not a runtime reproduction.
Repeated-sequence mining, editable multi-step workflows, per-step history, pause/skip and drift recovery are not evidenced as a connected customer workflow.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: After the foundation mapping is agreed, dispatch plan_meals to the existing meal domain service and persist verified output IDs before any handled status. Unsupported actions must remain actionable rather than report success; then extend reusable workflow controls.

capabilities.name: Family CFO

required.customerOutcome: Explain bills before payday and affordability of future commitments using deterministic, sourced forecasts and editable assumptions.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Role-private balances, inflows, bills, goals, calendar/trip/project costs, forecast/scenario UI and correction/provenance records.

evidence.observation: The inspected loader reads bills, goals, account balances and calendar titles/times, without income schedules or priced trip/project commitments.
The running balance subtracts outflows; calendar events are contextual labels rather than quantified commitments.

gaps.description: The inspected forecast cannot substantiate payday-aware affordability or include unrecorded future trip/project spend.
Scenario assumption editing, required finance tools, finance-specific role privacy and source-linked correction journeys remain unverified.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Extend the existing deterministic timeline with explicit income schedules and canonical future commitments, then expose one sourced bills-before-payday scenario with editable assumptions. Preserve existing finance UI and permission boundaries.

capabilities.name: Spending Intelligence

required.customerOutcome: Explain exact spending changes with transaction citations, household/seasonal baselines and corrections that improve later categorization.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Normalized merchants, transfer/refund treatment, anomaly and driver UI, editable categories, persisted corrections and source-linked financial records.

evidence.observation: The inspected CFO surface computes current-month category sums, not an explanation against an adaptive historical baseline.
The Expenses surface reads expense splits and shares for settlement, rather than supplying the spending-intelligence workflow.

gaps.description: Transaction-cited variance drivers, household/seasonal baselines and learned merchant/category corrections are not evidenced in the inspected finance and expense paths.
Correct treatment of transfers/refunds in the required spending-analysis workflow remains unverified; this is not a confirmed refund-calculation defect.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Use existing finance records to define normalized spend semantics and persistent corrections, then deliver one category-change explanation with exact contributing transaction IDs and baseline assumptions. Do not rebuild expense splitting.

capabilities.name: AI Meal Planner

required.customerOutcome: Produce safe, calendar-feasible meals that respect hard household restrictions and yield approved, deduplicated grocery changes.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Meal-plan approval/editing and swap UI tied to stored allergies/preferences, cooking windows, recipes, pantry, leftovers, feedback and grocery deltas.

evidence.observation: Dietary constraints in the inspected plan route come from the request; the path does not load stored member allergies as a mandatory server constraint.
Dietary compliance is requested in the model prompt.
Response parsing validates dates, meal types, references and duplicates but does not deterministically exclude allergens; generated dishes can lack ingredient evidence.
The inspected persistence path writes meal-plan rows without implementing an approved grocery-delta workflow.

gaps.description: Prompt-only dietary instructions do not satisfy the required deterministic allergy exclusion. The inspected write path can accept output without proving compliance.
Calendar cooking windows, pantry/leftover constraints, feedback-driven swaps and approved grocery deltas are not evidenced as a connected planning outcome in the inspected route.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Load authoritative household restrictions server-side and apply a deterministic eligibility gate before plan persistence, including generated dishes and unknown ingredients. Then connect calendar cooking windows and reuse existing grocery services for explicit approved deltas.

capabilities.name: Grocery Optimizer

required.customerOutcome: Turn household-sized recipes into a pantry-adjusted, consolidated, budget-aware basket with explainable substitutions and realistic store choices.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Quantity/unit conversion, pantry subtraction, price source/freshness, substitution locks, budget estimates and store splitting that includes travel/time costs; no unapproved purchasing.

evidence.observation: The grocery route renders ShoppingModule.
The routed screen reads grocery lists/items and provides list CRUD and checking rather than a price/pantry optimization pipeline.
Existing registered grocery tools cover add/list/check/clear operations and provide reusable validation and deduplication behavior.
Retailer support is explicitly links/copying, not ordering or a price-observation integration.

gaps.description: The inspected primary screen and registered tools do not deliver pantry subtraction, unit consolidation, source-dated budget optimization, substitution locks or travel-aware store splitting.
Real price-provider availability and truthful unavailable/stale estimate handling remain unverified.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Build a deterministic recipe-quantity to pantry-adjusted consolidated basket service over existing groceries. Add explicit price provenance/freshness and locked substitutions before any optional retailer handoff; never simulate ordering or price availability.

capabilities.name: Universal Inbox

required.customerOutcome: One captured source produces reviewed, linked canonical outcomes without duplicate writes, with preserved source evidence and reversible batch confirmation.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Email/image/PDF/voice/share ingestion, validation/OCR, entity resolution, confidence/edit UI, source-linked output batches, deduplication, replay and undo.

evidence.observation: Inbox AI import reduces returned proposals to summary strings and stores them as communication action_items, dropping typed action arguments.
Save to Hub inserts family_communications; it does not invoke the existing confirmed-action execution branch.
A separate confirmation branch already evaluates trust and dispatches approved actions, providing an implementation path to reuse.
The inspected capture undo deletes captured rows in one table, not a source-linked multi-domain import batch.
Paperwork materializes an action before separately stamping its materialized ID; this is not atomic replay-safe batch confirmation.

gaps.description: Saving an inbox import does not materialize the extracted typed proposals, despite the existing confirmation endpoint.
Source-linked batch confirmation, cross-source deduplication, atomic replay protection and multi-domain undo are not established by the inspected capture/paperwork paths.
The unified attachment/OCR/voice/entity-resolution journey remains unverified; separate capture mechanisms are not proof of that outcome.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Preserve typed proposals and source IDs in an import batch, then wire the existing parse/confirm flow to idempotent canonical writes with result IDs and compensating or atomic batch undo. Reuse existing capture and trust integrations.

capabilities.name: Wardrobe Assistant

required.customerOutcome: Recommend usable event- and weather-appropriate outfits and packing plans, including optional photo inventory, laundry availability and size changes.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Editable vision attributes, event dress requirements, weather, garment availability, size/growth reminders and linked trip packing/shopping tasks, without body inference.

evidence.observation: The module reads wardrobe items, outfits and wear logs and includes weather-assisted suggestions.
Outfit suggestion context comes from member, temperature, manually selected occasion and date, rather than an integrated event dress-requirement or trip workflow.
Photo handling uploads and stores an image path; editable garment attributes are manually entered rather than extracted by vision.

gaps.description: Photo-to-editable inventory, calendar-specific dress requirements and recommendation-to-trip-packing outcomes are not connected in the inspected module.
Child/object privacy, size-change reminders and the required wardrobe tool family remain unverified as complete customer workflows.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Extend the existing inventory with reviewed vision attributes and event/weather context, then connect recommendations to existing packing or shopping records. Keep manual inventory optional and enforce role/privacy constraints through the parent foundation.

capabilities.name: Decluttering

required.customerOutcome: A privacy-reviewed room photo becomes a realistic timed reset, age-appropriate assignments and a recorded before/after outcome.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Photo crop/review, 15/30/60-minute plans, timers/checkoff, after-photo and estimate feedback, recurring rooms, donate/sell/store decisions and canonical chore/inventory links.

evidence.observation: The module reads declutter zones, missions and sessions, providing existing persistence to extend.
Weekly plan assignment receives member IDs without age/role context, so this call does not establish age-appropriate assignment policy.
Completion updates a mission and logs a session; the inspected form does not implement a photo-to-canonical-chore reset workflow.

gaps.description: The inspected module does not connect privacy-reviewed photo analysis to a timed task plan, policy-aware assignments and an after-photo outcome.
Age/permission context and linked canonical chore/inventory outcomes are not established by the current weekly-plan and completion calls.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Reuse zones/missions/sessions for a reviewed photo-to-task proposal, with age/role-aware assignment and linked canonical chores. Add timed completion and after-photo evidence before claiming the reset outcome.

capabilities.name: Accountability

required.customerOutcome: Help a person start and complete a difficult task through blocker-aware microsteps, focus sessions and bounded personalized follow-up rather than an ephemeral checklist.
required.uiDataIntegrations: Persisted defer/blocker outcomes, decomposition, focus timer, user-controlled nudge frequency, permission-aware rescheduling/escalation and outcome learning over existing tasks/reminders.

evidence.observation: The focus screen builds a queue from today's events, chores and todos.
Completion invokes a handler only where supplied and otherwise advances local state; todo items have a persistence handler, while the inspected chore items do not.
Skip advances the local queue rather than persisting a defer reason or rescheduling outcome.

gaps.description: The inspected focus screen lacks persisted blocker/defer learning, microstep decomposition, a focus timer and adaptive bounded follow-up.
Required accountability tools and permission-aware rescheduling/escalation are not evidenced through this queue UI.

capabilities.firstSafeSlice: Persist blocker/defer outcomes against existing tasks and connect microstep decomposition plus a real focus session. Add opt-in bounded nudges and explicit rescheduling permissions through existing reminder services, not a new isolated task store.

recommendedSequence: Parent resolves the pending capability execution matrix/foundation contract; no foundation implementation is authorized by this report.
Address deterministic meal restriction enforcement and Autopilot false handled outcomes as the highest-impact capability slices.
Connect source-linked, replay-safe inbox confirmation as a reusable multi-domain persistence path.
Implement the remaining bounded capability slices against existing modules and canonical records rather than duplicating functionality.
